meta.title: Puntr | Predict smarter. Prove it.
meta.description: A Community-First Platform for South African sports fans. Picks locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever. PSL, EPL, UCL, URC and Springboks. 18+.
meta.ogDescription: Every pick is locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever. Build a record people can trust.

hero.body: Puntr is where South African sports fans back their judgement in public. Every pick is <1>locked at kick-off</1>, graded automatically and kept forever, so your <1>public record</1> speaks for you.

stamped.title: Timestamped before kick-off
stamped.body: A pick only counts if it was posted before the match started.

noEdits.title: No edits, no deletes
noEdits.body: Wins and losses stay on your record. Nothing disappears afterwards.

public.title: Public units, ROI and sample size
public.body: See how many picks sit behind a result before you trust it.

s1.title: Join free
s1.body: Create your account with an email code. You must be 18 or older.

s2.title: Post your picks
s2.body: Back your call on upcoming matches before kick-off.

s3.title: Get graded
s3.body: Every pick is <1>locked at kick-off</1> and settled automatically.

s4.title: Climb the weekly leaderboard
s4.body: Build a public record on units, ROI and sample size. Play for pride.

board.title: Weekly leaderboard
board.empty: No picks have been settled this week yet. Post a pick and be first on the board.

join.title: Why join Puntr?
join.f3: A public record you can share

platforms.title: Predictions across South Africa's bookmakers
platforms.body: Tipsters on Puntr record picks against the odds these platforms offer. Puntr does not take bets, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

preview.title: Soweto Derby
preview.locked: On Puntr this pick would be timestamped and locked at kick-off. It could not be edited or deleted.
preview.idle: Picks lock at kick-off and cannot be edited or deleted.
preview.fine: Sample split for illustration. Not a real prediction. Nothing you tap here is saved.
